surface_mechanism_description: Oxygen penetrates into the sub-surface region of a Ru film during the O2 exposure; and this stored oxygen significantly enhances the Ru precursor adsorption during the following Ru precursor pulse due to an oxide-catalyzed redox decomposition of the precursor molecules.
